description.zh:
用户登录云电脑后是否具有管理员权限。

> 该功能处于定向邀测中，暂不对外开放。
description.en:
Specifies whether a user has administrative permissions after logging on to the cloud computer.

> This feature is available only for invitational preview. It is not publicly available.

description.zh: 是否开启防截屏功能。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable screen capture prevention.

description.zh: 客户端IP白名单列表。
description.en: The client IP address whitelist.

description.zh: 客户端访问IP地址段。格式为CIDR格式的IPv4地址段。
description.en: The client IP address range. Specify the value in CIDR notation.

description.zh: 客户端IP白名单的描述信息。
description.en: The description of the client IP address whitelist.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则列表。
description.en: A list of security group rules.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的对象，CIDR格式的IPv4地址段。
description.en: The destination IPv4 address range. Specify the value in CIDR notation.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的描述信息。
description.en: The description of the security group rule.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的协议类型。
description.en: The protocol type of the security group rule.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的授权策略。
description.en: The policy of the security group rule.

description.zh:
安全组管控规则的端口范围。由协议（IpProtocol）的取值确定端口的取值范围：

- TCP协议或者UDP协议：端口取值范围为1~65535。使用斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
- ICMP协议：端口为-1/-1。
- GRE协议：端口为-1/-1。
- IpProtocol取值为all：端口为-1/-1。

典型应用的常用端口请参见[常用端口](~~40724~~)。
description.en:
The port range of the security group rule. The value of this parameter depends on the \`IpProtocol\` parameter:

- If the protocol is TCP or UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end port numbers. For example: 1/200.

- If the protocol is ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

- If the protocol is GRE, the port range is -1/-1.

- If IpProtocol is set to all, the port range is -1/-1.

For more information about common ports, see [Common ports](~~40724~~).

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的优先级。数字越小，代表优先级越高。取值范围：1\~60。默认值：1。
description.en: The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 60. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的规则方向。
description.en: The direction of the security group rule.

description.zh: 是否开启本地摄像头重定向。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable local camera redirection.

description.zh: 登录方式管控规则列表。
description.en: A list of logon method control rules.

description.zh:
登录方式管控，设置客户端类型。

> 如果不设置`ClientType`相关参数，则默认允许所有类型的客户端登录云电脑。
description.en:
The type of client.

> If you do not specify this parameter, logons from all client types are allowed by default.

description.zh:
登录方式管控，设置是否允许使用某一类型的客户端登录云电脑。

> 如果不设置`ClientType`相关参数，则默认允许所有类型的客户端登录云电脑。
description.en:
Specifies whether to allow logons from this client type.

> If you do not specify this parameter, logons from all client types are allowed by default.

description.zh: 剪贴板权限。
description.en: The clipboard redirection policy.

description.zh: 设备重定向规则列表。
description.en: The device redirection rules.

description.zh: 外设类型。
description.en: The type of peripheral device.

description.zh: 重定向类型。
description.en: The redirection type.

description.zh: 自定义外设规则列表。
description.en: The custom peripheral device rules.

description.zh: 设备名称。
description.en: The name of the device.

description.zh: 产品ID。
description.en: The product ID (PID).

description.zh: 外设类型。
description.en: The type of peripheral device.

description.zh: 生产厂商ID。参见[Valid USB Vendor IDs (VIDs)](https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf)。
description.en: The vendor ID (VID). For more information, see [Valid USB Vendor IDs](https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf).

description.zh: 链接优化指令。
description.en: The link optimization command.

description.zh: 重定向类型。
description.en: The redirection type.

description.zh: 管控访问域名权限，域名支持*通配符，多个域名之间以英文逗号隔开。
description.en: The domain names that can be accessed. Wildcard characters (\*) are supported. Separate multiple domain names with commas.

description.zh: 域名解析策略详情。
description.en: The details of the domain name resolution policy.

description.zh: 策略描述。
description.en: The description of the policy.

description.zh: 域名。
description.en: The domain name.

description.zh: 解析策略。
description.en: The resolution policy.

description.zh: 域名解析策略类型。
description.en: The type of domain name resolution policy.

description.zh: 用户申请管理员协助开关。
description.en: Specifies whether to allow users to request assistance from the administrator.

description.zh: 用户之间流协同开关。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable stream collaboration between users.

description.zh: 是否为图形型规格云电脑开启画质策略。对云电脑性能和使用体验要求较高时，例如专业设计场景下，建议开启该策略。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the image quality policy for graphics cloud desktops. Enabling this policy improves performance and user experience in professional design scenarios.

description.zh:
Web客户端访问策略。

> 推荐您使用`ClientType`相关参数统一管控登录方式。
description.en:
The policy for access from web clients.

> Use the `ClientType` parameter to manage logon methods.

description.zh: Web客户端文件传输策略。
description.en: The policy for file transfers from web clients.

description.zh: 网络通信协议。
description.en: The network communication protocol.

description.zh: 本地磁盘映射权限。
description.en: The local disk mapping policy.

description.zh: 云电脑由于客观原因造成断开连接的最大连接重试时间。取值范围：30\~7200，单位：秒。
description.en: The maximum amount of time that the client can attempt to reconnect to the cloud computer after an unexpected disconnection. Valid values: 30 to 7200. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 云电脑策略名称。
description.en: The name of the cloud computer policy.

description.zh:
网络重定向。

> 该功能处于定向邀测中，暂不对外开放。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable network redirection.

> This feature is available only for invitational preview. It is not publicly available.

description.zh: 云电脑策略ID。
description.en: The ID of the cloud computer policy.

description.zh:
云电脑抢占策略。

> 为保证正在使用云电脑的终端用户的操作体验和数据安全，暂不允许多个用户之间互相抢占，即该配置默认为`off`，且不可修改。
description.en:
The policy for preemptible logon.

> To ensure the user experience and data security of the current user, other users cannot preempt the cloud computer. This parameter is set to `off` by default and cannot be changed.

description.zh:
可抢占云电脑的一组用户的用户名，最多可以设置5个。

> 为保证正在使用云电脑的终端用户的操作体验和数据安全，暂不允许多个用户之间互相抢占。
description.en:
The usernames of users who can preempt the logon of a cloud computer. You can specify up to five usernames.

> To ensure the user experience and data security of the current user, other users cannot preempt the cloud computer.

description.zh: 打印机重定向。
description.en: The printer redirection policy.

description.zh: 是否开启自定义录屏。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable custom screen recording.

description.zh: 自定义录屏的文件过期时间，默认30天。
description.en: The expiration time of custom screen recording files. The default value is 30. Unit: days.

description.zh: 是否开启录屏。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable screen recording.

description.zh: 录制云电脑声音选项。
description.en: Specifies whether to record audio from the cloud computer.

description.zh: 录屏文件阅览时长，单位为分钟。录制文件会根据您设置的时长自动切分并上传至存储空间，文件达到300MB时优先滚动更新。
description.en: The duration for viewing a screen recording file. Unit: minutes. The recorded files are automatically split into chunks and uploaded to a bucket based on the specified duration. When a file reaches 300 MB, it is overwritten on a rolling basis.

description.zh: 录屏结束时间，取值：HH:MM:SS。只有`Recording`取值是`PERIOD`时，该返回值有实际意义。
description.en: The end time of the screen recording. The time is in the HH:MM:SS format. This parameter is valid only when \`Recording\` is set to \`PERIOD\`.

description.zh: 录屏文件的保留时间。取值范围为1\~180天。
description.en: The retention period of screen recording files. Valid values: 1 to 180. Unit: days.

description.zh: 录屏帧率。单位：FPS（帧/秒）。
description.en: The frame rate for screen recording. Unit: frames per second (fps).

description.zh: 录屏开始时间，取值：HH:MM:SS。只有`Recording`取值是`PERIOD`时，该返回值有实际意义。
description.en: The start time of the screen recording. The time is in the HH:MM:SS format. This parameter is valid only when \`Recording\` is set to \`PERIOD\`.

description.zh: 录屏客户端消息通知功能。
description.en: Specifies whether to send a notification to the client when a screen recording starts.

description.zh: 录屏客户端通知内容。默认无需填写。
description.en: The content of the screen recording notification. This parameter is optional.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. Call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions that WUYING Workspace supports.

description.zh: 远程协助键鼠控制权限。
description.en: The remote assistance policy for keyboard and mouse control.

description.zh: 待删除客户端IP白名单列表。
description.en: The client IP address whitelist to delete.

description.zh: 待删除客户端访问IP地址段。格式为CIDR格式的IPv4地址段。
description.en: The client IP address range to delete. Specify the value in CIDR notation.

description.zh: 待删除客户端IP白名单的描述信息。
description.en: The description of the client IP address whitelist to delete.

description.zh: 待删除安全组管控规则列表。
description.en: The security group rules to delete.

description.zh: 待删除安全组管控规则的对象，CIDR格式的IPv4地址段。
description.en: The destination IPv4 address range to delete. Specify the value in CIDR notation.

description.zh: 待删除安全组管控规则的描述信息。
description.en: The description of the security group rule to delete.

description.zh: 待删除安全组管控规则的协议类型。
description.en: The protocol type of the security group rule to delete.

description.zh: 待删除安全组管控规则的授权策略。
description.en: The policy of the security group rule to delete.

description.zh:
待删除安全组管控规则的端口范围。由协议（IpProtocol）的取值确定端口的取值范围：

- TCP协议或者UDP协议：端口取值范围为1~65535。使用斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
- ICMP协议：端口为-1/-1。
- GRE协议：端口为-1/-1。
- IpProtocol取值为all：端口为-1/-1。

典型应用的常用端口请参见[常用端口](~~40724~~)。
description.en:
The port range of the security group rule to delete. The value of this parameter depends on the \`IpProtocol\` parameter:

- If the protocol is TCP or UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end port numbers. For example: 1/200.

- If the protocol is ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

- If the protocol is GRE, the port range is -1/-1.

- If IpProtocol is set to all, the port range is -1/-1.

For more information about common ports, see [Common ports](~~40724~~).

description.zh: 待删除安全组管控规则的优先级。数字越小，代表优先级越高。取值范围：1\~60。默认值：1。
description.en: The priority of the security group rule to delete. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 60. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 待删除安全组管控规则的规则方向。
description.en: The direction of the security group rule to delete.

description.zh: 策略的生效范围。
description.en: The scope of the policy.

description.zh: `Scope`取值为`IP`的时候填写。当`Scope`为`IP`时生效，否则不生效。
description.en: The value of the scope. This parameter is valid only when \`Scope\` is set to \`IP\`.

description.zh: USB重定向。
description.en: The USB redirection policy.

description.zh: USB重定向规则。
description.en: The USB redirection rules.

description.zh: 规则描述。
description.en: The description of the rule.

description.zh: 设备类别，当`usbRuleType`为1的时候需要填写。参见[Defined Class Codes](https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes)。
description.en: The device class. This parameter is required when \`UsbRuleType\` is set to 1. For more information, see [Defined Class Codes](https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes).

description.zh: 设备子类别，当`usbRuleType`为1的时候需要填写。参见[Defined Class Codes](https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes)。
description.en: The device subclass. This parameter is required when \`UsbRuleType\` is set to 1. For more information, see [Defined Class Codes](https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes).

description.zh: 产品ID。
description.en: The product ID (PID).

description.zh: USB重定向类型。
description.en: The USB redirection type.

description.zh: USB重定向规则类型。
description.en: The type of USB redirection rule.

description.zh: 生产厂商ID。参见[Valid USB Vendor IDs (VIDs)](https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf)。
description.en: The vendor ID (VID). For more information, see [Valid USB Vendor IDs](https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf).

description.zh: 多媒体重定向。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable multimedia redirection.

description.zh: 图像显示质量策略。
description.en: The image display quality.

description.zh: 水印。
description.en: The watermark policy.

description.zh: 盲水印防拍照功能。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the screen capture prevention watermark feature.

description.zh: 水印字体颜色。 取值范围：0\~16777215。
description.en: The font color of the watermark. Valid values: 0 to 16777215.

description.zh: 水印倾斜度。取值范围：-10\~-30 。
description.en: The angle of the watermark. Valid values: -10 to -30.

description.zh: 水印字体大小。 取值范围：10\~20。
description.en: The font size of the watermark. Valid values: 10 to 20.

description.zh: 水印字体样式。
description.en: The font style of the watermark.

description.zh: 盲水印增强功能。
description.en: The strength of the blind watermark.

description.zh:
水印行数。

> 此参数暂未开放使用。
description.en:
The number of watermark rows.

> This parameter is not yet available.

description.zh: 盲水印安全优先规则。
description.en: The security priority rule for watermarks.

description.zh: 水印显示的深浅程度。
description.en: The transparency of the watermark.

description.zh: 水印透明度，值越大，透明度越小。 取值范围：10\~100。
description.en: The transparency of the watermark. A larger value indicates lower transparency. Valid values: 10 to 100.

description.zh:
水印类型。最多可以选择3个类型，用半角逗号隔开。

> 若传入`custom`，则必须同时通过参数`WatermarkCustomText`传入自定义文本的内容。
description.en:
The type of watermark. You can specify up to three types. Separate them with commas.

> If you set this parameter to `Custom`, you must also specify the custom text in the `WatermarkCustomText` parameter.

description.zh: 是否在云电脑悬浮球内提供无影AI助手功能入口。
description.en: Specifies whether to display the entry for Alibaba Cloud AI Assistant in the floating bar of the cloud computer.
